query:
SELECT t.id, t.name, t.email, t.role, t.status, u.role as user_role 
FROM technicians t 
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.userId 
WHERE t.status = 'active' 
AND t.email NOT IN ('sensei30002003@gmail.com', 'cloverdojo@gmail.com', 'chrismpamugo99@gmail.com')
ORDER BY t.name;
